assets.semantic_intent: Generic prismatic rectangular structural-member intent for coordination, section-property handoff and bounded analytical references; capacity is never inferred from geometry alone.

applicability.notes: Not a member-capacity, reinforcement, stability or code-compliance claim without exact section/material/load/standard calculation evidence.

rules: member role and end/support relationships must be explicit
section and material identity must remain source-bound
geometry alone must not activate capacity claims

assets.semantic_intent: Connection-interface intent capturing connected member identities, force-transfer role, ownership and unresolved design dependency without inventing connection geometry or resistance.

applicability.notes: Not a designed or adequate connection; fasteners, welds, plates, anchors, stiffness and resistance require an implemented connection-design route with exact evidence.

rules: all connected semantic members must be identified
open connection design remains a release blocker where adequacy is required
native placeholder geometry cannot be treated as connection design

conditions: a generic interface marker is not a substitute for a designed connection

assets.semantic_intent: Foundation/support interface intent linking superstructure load-path terminals to a declared foundation/geotechnical dependency without inventing footing, pile or soil capacity.

applicability.notes: Not a foundation or geotechnical adequacy claim; exact reactions, foundation system, soil/geotechnical data and applicable design rules remain separate required evidence.

rules: superstructure terminal identity must be explicit
support geometry must not imply soil or foundation capacity

conditions: a foundation-interface marker cannot replace geotechnical/foundation design
